mentions.heading: Difficulties launching new programs to customers' timing, performance and quality standards
mentions.detail: Automotive program launches depend on customer design changes, tooling readiness, skilled labor; failures may trigger commercial or litigation claims and reputational harm
mentions.quote: Given the complexity of new program launches, we may experience difficulties managing product quality, timeliness and associated costs. Failure by us to successfully launch a new product could result in commercial or litigation claims against us which could have a material adverse effect on our profitability.

mentions.heading: New program launch costs ahead of customer vehicle introductions
mentions.detail: Significant cost ramp for new programs while sales depend on timing and success of customers' new vehicle introductions
mentions.quote: In addition, new program launches require a significant ramp up of costs; however, our sales related to these new programs generally are dependent upon the timing and success of our customers’ introduction of new vehicles.
